instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: In 1922, Howard Carter and Lord Carnarvon uncovered the tomb of Tutankhamun. The tomb contained many weapons, pieces of furniture and jewellery, and Tutankhamun’s famous gold mask.

The discovery of Tutankhamun’s tomb was very significant, as it had barely been disturbed by tomb raiders — unlike the majority of other Egyptian tombs! As a result, it offered a rare, detailed glimpse into ancient Egyptian life.

atoms.a: Which two people discovered the tomb of Tutankhamun in 1922?
For which two reasons was Tutankhamun’s tomb significant?
b: ++It had hardly been disturbed by tomb raiders.
++It provided a unique insight into ancient Egyptian life.
